description: Rows of a table, region or dataset that meet every filter, sorted, each cell typed with its address; total is the count of all matches. Paged as xlsx_read.

columns.description: Columns to give, by name. Default all.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, with the same call.

doc.description: Document id; not needed for a dataset (d:).

limit.description: Rows per page. Default 50, at most 500.

sort.description: Sort keys, first decides first. Other types, then blanks, last.

table.description: A table or region (t:Products, t:Stock!A1) or dataset (d:by_region).

where.description: Filters, all met. value as JSON writes it: 12.5, true, dates ISO (2026-01-05), percent as the fraction. gte/lte: numbers, dates, times. contains: text, case ignored; eq/in match exactly; contains_any: any of values.

loose.description: Text ignoring case and all white space.

name: xlsx_query
